info.title: Legal Compliance Checker — proposed frontend API
info.description: Design contract for frontend mocks/client generation and backend implementation. Proposed endpoints do not run. See x-implementation-status per operation; The running backend exposes its runtime schema at /openapi.json. Auth/error envelope are proposed. Decimal values can be JSON strings: do not assume floating-point money. Unknown/null and review/uncertainty states must remain visible.
